facts.fact: 1942年12月6日Béatrice和Fanny到Drancy（Cité de la Muette）；1941–1944年>70,000人经过；"中转营是你消失之前经过的地方"；距两个火车站十分钟，铁路直通Auschwitz-Birkenau。
facts.anchor: The transit camp was the place you passed through before you disappeared.

facts.fact: Béatrice的改宗对检查员毫无意义；登记卡预先打好特殊代码"par %A.A. IV J."（来自Gestapo犹太科）；标注"À ne pas libérer"（不得释放）；Göring名言："Wer Jude ist, bestimme Ich"（谁是犹太人由我决定）。
facts.anchor: Béatrice’s Catholic conversion meant nothing to the inspectors. She still carried, on their paper, the wrong ancestry.

facts.fact: Marya Freund（波兰女高音，67岁）："我不再是歌手、音乐教师、荣誉军团骑士、公主伯爵夫人的朋友。我什么都不是。"；Béatrice在Drancy削土豆、扫地板、洗自己的衣服；Marya五周后通过Rothschild救济院逃脱。
facts.anchor: I was no longer a singer, a music teacher, a Chevalier de Legion d’Honneur, a friend of princesses and countesses and influential people. I was nothing.”

facts.fact: Ginette Appel（24岁，室友）1998年回忆："她们以为很快就会离开，完全不知道等待她们的是什么"；Béatrice保持尊严、 partly deaf、用园丁偷送的围裙擦楼梯；Fanny开玩笑说自己"出生在博物馆里"。
facts.anchor: Ginette Appel, then twenty-four, was one of their roommates in the cramped bunk room draped with drying laundry. She remembered them clearly—Béatrice and Fanny, the mother and daughter who still believed this would not last.

facts.fact: 1943年6月18日Brunner（31岁）到任；Eichmann称他"我最好的人之一"；2500囚犯被叫到 courtyard 逐一"面试"（实为判刑仪式）；两堆纸：一堆生命、一堆驱逐；6月21日编好1018人名单。
facts.anchor: He sat flanked by SS loyalists from Austria and a French functionary from the Commissariat-General for Jewish Affairs. He addressed the prisoners in a monotone voice and made two stacks of paper, one pile for life, the other for deportation.

facts.fact: 1943年3月24日德国军官打字备忘录 urging 驱逐全家四口；描述Léon"典型犹太人特征（弯鼻、厚唇、割礼、据称无宗教）"；7月13日全家被分为Category III（不立即驱逐）——"不是自由，但在Drancy，'某物'就是一切"。
facts.anchor: He has the typical characteristics of the Jew (bent nose, bulging lips, and is circumcised and supposedly non-religious). He behaves impudently and arrogantly in the camp, and it is proposed that he and his family be included in one of the next Jewish transports.”

facts.fact: 章末：Julien Reinach（Léon兄弟）9月23日在Villa Kérylos被捕、27日到Drancy；Allatini夫妇死于Auschwitz（1943初）；Jeanne Montefiore死于Auschwitz（1943-07）；"希望成为他们的抵抗，拒绝已为他们写好的安静抹除"；Staircase 21下面的地道计划正在成形。
facts.anchor: Hope became their resistance, a way to refuse the quiet erasure already written for them. A conspiracy was evolving into a scheme: a tunnel under Staircase 21.
